# glpi_device_graphic_card (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI graphic card model in the device catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_device_graphic_card" "by_name" {
  name = "NVIDIA RTX A6000"
}

data "glpi_device_graphic_card" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Designation of the graphic card. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `chipset` (String) Chipset.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `default_memory` (Number) Default memory in MB.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the manufacturer.
